performers.asset: KayKit_Mystery_Series6/6 - December 2023 - Action Figure · Köpfe Normal/B/C/D
performers.role: Plastik-Kommando, hält Wrestling für Fake und sich für den einzigen echten Kämpfer; vier Köpfe, ein Gesicht, eine aufgemalte Narbe

structure: PROBE nach BBBW_DECKVERSTAENDNIS_R1: Intro (Titel + Cover-These), eine Bewohner-Zeile, Kette Economy of Real Ego 10 -> 33 -> 35 -> 55 (Ego verweigert -> Shooter erzwingt -> es wird echt -> das Geschaeft vertuscht), Outro mit Callback auf die Narbe aus dem Intro.
synopsis: A spoken-word number from a card deck about the psychology of professional wrestling. It is performed by a toy figure in its home, a toy box, for whoever happens to be there.
bestOfReason: PROBE: 10, 33, 35, 55 als eine Kausalkette aus dem Kartensinn (No-Sell verweigert, Shooter 'stiff the no-seller', Real Injury, Kayfabe Police).
beats: Big Bad Brain Wrestling: the physics of fake pain and the economy of real ego.
Toy box, cardboard ring. Me: commando, four heads, one real scar. Everybody else in here just wrestles.

beats.text: The No-Sell Monster ignores damage, sits right back up: remove all tension for ego.
The Shooter forces opponent to sell; if they refuse, real damage. Stiff the no-seller.
The Real Injury, unplanned: Goldberg's shoulder, ring-post. Crowd goes nuts because it's real.
The Kayfabe Police enforce the lie: arrest anyone breaking character. Keep secrets secret.

beats: The Kayfabe Police never came for me. I call it fake all day, with my one real scar painted on all four heads.
